images.01: Year 2050, futuristic bright Tashkent apartment at sunrise, smart glass windows showing Tashkent TV tower among green skyscrapers; a friendly white humanoid home robot opens the curtains while Uzbek man Akmal, 40, short black hair, neat stubble, wakes up in bed stretching. Clean white, mint and warm gold palette.
images.02: Year 2050 kitchen: friendly white humanoid robot with a soft blue face screen, wearing a colorful Uzbek atlas-pattern apron, serving breakfast with non bread, tea and a cup of coffee on a modern table, futuristic but cozy.
images.02_b: SMALL CHANGE: same picture, but the robot now winks with its screen face and gives a thumbs up.
images.03: Elderly Uzbek man, about 75, white embroidered doppi skullcap, grey mustache, modern grey cardigan, sitting at a futuristic breakfast table holding a round traditional non bread and frowning skeptically at a humanoid robot, year 2050, comic expression.
images.04: Wide illustration: a long row of many different humanoid robots silhouetted in a huge bright futuristic factory hall, assembly lights, blue and silver palette, sense of scale.
images.05: Year 2050, a sleek white electric air taxi with several rotors flying over Tashkent with the Tashkent TV tower and green parks below, morning sky; inside the window Uzbek man Akmal, 40, in a silver jacket, smiling; small delivery drones around.
images.06: Rooftop air-taxi pad in 2050 Tashkent: elderly Uzbek man in white doppi and grey cardigan raising his arm high and waving at the sky like stopping a street taxi, an air taxi hovering above, his son in a silver jacket laughing next to him.
images.07: Year 2050 family dinner in a modern Uzbek home: elderly father in white doppi proudly serving plov from a big kazan, son Akmal in a silver jacket, his wife and kids around a dastarkhan, a humanoid robot politely holding a plate, warm evening light, cozy.
